system.name: Canon
system.one_liner: a 2D-mesh spatial architecture that combines dynamic data-driven orchestration via programmable FSMs with time-lapsed SIMD execution

components.name: Orchestrator
components.role: row-level FSM control unit issuing instructions to its PE row

components.name: S1
components.role: FSM state corresponding to output instruction inst1

components.name: S2
components.role: FSM state corresponding to output instruction inst2

components.name: PE
components.role: processing element executing the instruction issued by its row's orchestrator

components.name: PE Array
components.role: grid of PEs organized in rows and columns, each row driven by one orchestrator

content.key_idea: A message from a neighboring (north) orchestrator can trigger a row orchestrator's FSM to transition state at runtime, changing the instruction it issues to its PE row from inst2 to inst1, illustrating dynamic data-driven instruction issue.
content.reading_order: Top row first (Orchestrator with S1/S2 issuing inst2 to PE[0,0] and PE[1,0] with +3 cycles staggering), then the msg arrow down to the second row's Orchestrator, which switches from inst2 to inst1 before issuing to its PEs.

summary: This figure illustrates Canon's data-driven orchestration mechanism with a minimal two-row example. Each row of the PE Array is controlled by its own Orchestrator, whose FSM (states S1, S2) determines the instruction issued to that row's PEs; PEs in the same row execute the same instruction staggered by a few cycles (annotated +3 cycles) as part of time-lapsed SIMD execution. Initially both rows' orchestrators issue inst2. A message (msg) sent from the first (North) orchestrator to the second (South) orchestrator triggers the second row's FSM to transition from state S2 to S1, changing its issued instruction from inst2 to inst1. The figure is a sparse, green/magenta color-coded diagram emphasizing how compile-time FSM programming combines with a runtime message to adapt instruction issue on the fly.
summary_zh: 该图用两行 PE 的简例说明 Canon 的数据驱动编排机制：每行由一个 Orchestrator（内含 FSM，状态 S1/S2）控制指令下发，PE 间按周期错开执行；北侧 Orchestrator 发出的 msg 触发南侧 Orchestrator 的 FSM 从 S2 转换到 S1，使其下发指令由 inst2 变为 inst1。
